behavior: The sign-in page is Forwend's own: our email-code, Google and passkey forms on a branded page
acceptance: /sign-in is our own page: the landing hero's dawn (night in dark mode) horizon as a band that fades into the page, then one centered form (vertically centered on phones and tablets) built from ui-web components and tokens: email, then a 6-box CodeInput with one-time-code autofill and paste cleanup, resend and change email; Google. No cards, badges, sample data or extra copy; the Privy modal is not used; passkey sign-in is left out until users can add a passkey; errors are announced, name the field and the fix, and never move the form; CodeInput appears on /kit with its states. On phones the landing hero centers its headline and form in the first screen, with the river starting below it

The live Playwright test signs in the Privy test account through our form (pasted code with a space) and lands in /app; a wrong email and a wrong code each show only their own error; axe finds no serious or critical violation on /sign-in in both themes, on the code step and on the error states
notes: 2026-10-09 review pass by subagent: Our own /sign-in on Privy headless hooks (email code + Google), landing hero dawn/night band, one centered form. Earlier findings fixed: passkey removed (docs say it returns later); Google error read from useLoginWithOAuth state, so a wrong email code no longer shows it (live test); TextField/CodeInput errors and form messages announced; CodeInput has no maxLength (pasted '123 456' signs in, live test), stays enabled while checking so focus is kept; auto-submit once per attempt+code, works after resend, Sign in retries; Button loading blocks double send; send failure is a generic form message; space kept for errors so the form does not move (boundingBox test); unbuilt-feature facts removed; '/' uses APP_ROUTES.site; meadow images and rows removed (images-check 10/10). Fresh verify 20:52:38Z passed (6 live tests incl. axe on both themes, code step, error states). Re-checked: lint, typecheck, unit 8/8, docs-check. Nits only: Messages comment still mentions a card; /kit 'Code (checking)' shows a disabled state the page no longer uses.
